test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 25 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.

He distracted him while his partner __burgled__ his shop.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4' i.e. 'Looted'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Burgled"** refers to forcing an entry into a building or premises with the intent to commit an offence, especially theft.(चोरी करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Their house was burgled while they were on holiday.
 
 
 
• The word** "Looted"** means steal goods from (a place), typically during a war or riot. It's a synonym of 'burgled'.(लूटना)
 
 
• **Example:** The invaders looted the town.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct answer is - 'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, **"Burnt" **refers to something that is destroyed or badly damaged by fire. (जलाया हुआ)
 
• Option 2,** "Rooted**" means establish deeply and firmly.(जड़ देना)
 
• Option 3, **"Arrived**" means to come to a place at the end of a journey or a stage in a journey. (पहुँचना)
